This grows out_proj input_dim = H*d_v from 6*16=96 to 6*64=384 (auto-propagated: v_lut output_dim=d_v, out_proj input_dim=H*d_v, forward reshape H*d_v). q/k unchanged (d_qk=64). description: exp_g_0021 - exp_g_0020_smallE_concat_readoutlut with ONE change: out_proj's DECOMPRESS stage removed via out_inner_out 48 -> -1. CompressionMHL then sets has_decompress=False and eff_out = output_dim = 64, so the per-head FastMHL cells emit directly at 64 wide and the 8 heads are SUMMED to [N,64] (batched path: `return y.sum(dim=1)`), instead of concatenating to [N,8*48=384] and passing through a decompress Linear(384 -> 64). Net effect on out_proj: table cells widen 48 -> 64 (tables 8*128*2^6*48 -> 8*128*2^6*64, +1,048,576/layer) while the decompress Linear (384*64+64 = 24,640/layer) disappears -- so the site GROWS. Everything else identical to exp_g_0020: residual_sum, readout LUT between its two LayerNorms, E=64, d_qk=64, d_v=16, interior H*d_v=96, out_proj inner_in=48 nap=6 tph=128 n_heads=8, 6 layers, seq 512, vocab 32768, 24,576 tok/step, 16,000 steps. Shared lutorch NOT modified; readout LUT and q/k/v LUTs untouched.
